props.title: World Record

sections.content: **World Record** (2003) stands as one of the most visually striking segments from **The Animatrix** (2003), blending sports drama with mind-bending sci-fi in the Matrix universe. Director Takeshi Koike, known for his work on **Redline** (2009), brings his signature kinetic animation style to tell the story of Dan Davis, a sprinter who nearly breaks free from the Matrix through sheer physical willpower. The segment draws clear inspiration from **Akira** (1988), particularly in its body-horror elements and exploration of human potential breaking through artificial constraints.

sections.content: The theme of breaking physical limitations appears throughout anime sports films, but **World Record** uniquely merges this with cyberpunk elements. Similar philosophical questions about reality and human potential emerge in **Paprika** (2006) and **Ghost in the Shell** (1995), where characters push against the boundaries between physical and digital existence. The segment's distinctive visual style, with its extreme perspectives and fluid motion, influenced later sports anime like **Ping Pong: The Animation** (2014).

The integration of sports and science fiction elements in **World Record** created a template for genre-blending animation. Films like **Summer Wars** (2009) and **Belle** (2021) followed this path, mixing athletic achievement with digital world-breaking. The segment's exploration of physical transcendence particularly resonates with **Perfect Blue** (1997), where the protagonist's reality similarly fractures under extreme physical and mental stress. sections.content: What sets **World Record** apart is its raw depiction of athletic achievement as a path to enlightenment. This theme appears in more grounded sports anime like **The First Slam Dunk** (2022) and **Run with the Wind** (2018), but **World Record** elevates it to metaphysical levels. The segment's influence can be seen in later works like **Children of the Sea** (2019), where physical achievement leads to cosmic awareness.
